title: Combat · Command menu
description: The battle menu: Atacar, Habilidad, ?????, Defender and Huir. Habilidad opens its skills sideways; △ / Y (I on the keyboard) floats a details window beside the focused skill. Gerard starts with Análisis Parálisis alone and Bernat has no skills; at 35 with Noísta Gerard also has No-ta.

steps.caption: Gerard's turn: Atacar, Habilidad, ?????, Defender, Huir
Habilidad opens to the right while the other commands step back
Gerard's only skill: Análisis Parálisis, with the △ / I details hint
△ / Y (I on the keyboard): what the skill does, beside it
The party is boosted (▲ 3); Bernat has no skills, so Habilidad is greyed out
Gerard at 35 wearing Noísta: Análisis Parálisis and No-ta, details on No-ta
